caption:
Your personal details and photos never touch a remote server while creating your biodata.

When preparing a marriage biodata, keeping your personal information private is essential. With RishtaPatra, local-first design means every detail, photo and imported resume is processed in the browser and saved only on the device; an account is optional.

Visit rishtapatra.com to create your biodata safely.
